sn22.79:1.2: ye hi keci bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussaramānā anussaranti, sabbe te pañcupādānakkhandhe anussaranti, etesaṃ vā aññataraṃ.
sn22.79:1.5: iti vā hi bhikkhave, anussaramāno rūpaññeva anussarati.
sn22.79:1.7: iti vā bhikkhave, anussaramāno vedanaññeva anussarati.
sn22.79:1.8: evaṃsaññī ahosiṃ atītamaddhānanti iti vā bhikkhave anussaramāno saññaṃ yeva anussarati.
sn22.79:1.9: evaṃsaṅkhāro ahosiṃ atītamaddhānanti iti vā hi bhikkhave anussaramāno saṃkhāreyeva anussarati.
sn22.79:1.11: iti vā hi bhikkhave, anussaramāno viññāṇameva anussarati.
sn22.79:2.2: ruppatīti kho bhikkhave, tasmā rūpanti vuccati.
sn22.79:2.4: sītena’pi ruppati, uṇhena’pi ruppati, jighacchāya’pi ruppati, pipāsāya’pi ruppati, ḍaṃsamakasavātātapasiriṃsapasamphassena’pi ruppati.
sn22.79:2.5: ruppatīti kho bhikkhave, tasmā rūpanti vuccati.
sn22.79:3.2: vediyatīti kho bhikkhave, tasmā vedanāti vuccati.
sn22.79:3.4: sukhampi vediyati, dukkhampi vediyati, adukkhamasukhampi vediyati.
sn22.79:3.5: vediyatīti kho bhikkhave, tasmā vedanāti vuccati.
sn22.79:4.2: sañjānātīti kho bhikkhave, tasmā saññāti vuccati.
sn22.79:4.4: nīlampi sañjānāti; pītakampi sañjānāti; lohitakampi sañjānāti; odātampi sañjānāti.
sn22.79:4.5: sañjānātīti kho bhikkhave, tasmā saññāti vuccati.
sn22.79:5.2: saṅkhataṃ abhisaṅkharontīti bhikkhave, tasmā saṅkhārāti vuccanti.
sn22.79:5.4: rūpaṃ rūpattāya saṅkhataṃ abhisaṅkharonti. vedanaṃ vedanattāya saṅkhataṃ abhisaṅkharonti. saññaṃ saññattāya saṅkhataṃ abhisaṅkharonti. saṅkhāre saṅkhārattāya saṅkhataṃ abhisaṅkharonti, viññāṇaṃ viññāṇattāya saṅkhataṃ abhisaṅkharonti.
sn22.79:5.5: saṅkhataṃ abhisaṅkharontīti kho bhikkhave, tasmā saṅkhārāti vuccanti.
sn22.79:6.2: vijānātīti kho bhikkhave, tasmā viññāṇanti vuccati.
sn22.79:6.4: ambilampi vijānāti, tittakampi vijānāti, kaṭukampi vijānāti, madhurakampi vijānāti, khārikampi vijānāti, akhārikampi vijānāti, loṇikampi vijānāti, aloṇikampi vijānāti.
sn22.79:6.5: vijānātīti kho bhikkhave, tasmā viññāṇanti vuccati.
sn22.79:7.1: tatra bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati:
sn22.79:7.3: atītampahaṃ addhānaṃ evameva rūpena khajjiṃ, seyyathāpi etarahi paccuppannena rūpena khajjāmi.
sn22.79:7.4: ahaṃ ceva kho pana anāgataṃ rūpaṃ abhinandeyyaṃ, anāgatampahaṃ addhānaṃ evameva rūpena khajjeyyaṃ, seyyathāpi etarahi paccuppannena rūpena khajjāmīti.
sn22.79:7.5: so iti paṭisaṅkhāya atītasmiṃ rūpasmiṃ anapekho hoti
sn22.79:7.7: paccuppannassa rūpassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
sn22.79:8.2: atītampahaṃ addhānaṃ evameva vedanāya khajjiṃ, seyyathāpi etarahi paccuppannāya vedanāya khajjāmi.
sn22.79:8.3: ahaṃ ceva kho pana anāgataṃ vedanaṃ abhinandeyyaṃ
sn22.79:8.4: anāgatampapahaṃ addhānaṃ evameva vedanāya khajjeyyaṃ, seyyathāpi etarahi paccuppannāya vedanāya khajjāmīti.
sn22.79:8.5: so iti paṭisaṅkhāya atītāya vedanāya anapekho hoti,
sn22.79:8.7: paccuppannāya vedanāya nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
sn22.79:9.3: atītampahaṃ addhānaṃ evameva saṅkhārehi khajjiṃ, seyyathāpi etarahi paccuppannehi saṅkhārehi khajjāmi. ahaṃ
sn22.79:9.4: ceva kho pana anāgate saṅkhāre abhinandeyyaṃ,
sn22.79:9.5: anāgatampahaṃ addhānaṃ evameva saṅkhārehi khajjeyyaṃ, seyyathāpi etarahi paccuppannehi saṅkhārehi khajjāmīti.
sn22.79:9.6: so iti paṭisaṅkhāya atītesu saṅkhāresu anapekho hoti;
sn22.79:9.8: paccuppannānaṃ saṅkhārānaṃ nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
sn22.79:10.2: atītampāhaṃ addhānaṃ evameva viññāṇena khajjiṃ, seyyathāpi etarahi paccuppannena viññāṇena khajjāmi.
sn22.79:10.3: ahaṃ ceva kho pana anāgataṃ viññāṇaṃ abhinandeyyaṃ,
sn22.79:10.4: anāgatampahaṃ addhānaṃ evameva viññāṇena khajjeyyaṃ, seyyathāpi etarahi paccuppannena viññāṇena khajjāmi.
sn22.79:10.5: so iti paṭisaṅkhāya atītasmiṃ viññāṇasmiṃ anapekho hoti
sn22.79:10.7: paccuppannassa viññāṇassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
sn22.79:11.6: yampanāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ:
sn22.79:11.16: yampanāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ:
sn22.79:11.19: tasmātiha bhikkhave, yaṃ kiñci rūpaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā, sabbaṃ rūpaṃ “netaṃ mama, neso’hamasmi, na me so attā”ti, evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
sn22.79:11.23: yaṃ kiñci viññāṇaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā, sabbaṃ viññāṇaṃ “netaṃ mama, neso’hamasmi, na meso attā”ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
sn22.79:12.1: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako apacināti, no ācināti,
sn22.79:13.1: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmimpi nibbindati, vedanāya’pi nibbindati, saññāyapi …pe… saṅkhāresupi …pe… viññāṇasmimpi nibbindati.
sn22.79:13.2: nibbindaṃ virajjati. virāgā vimuccati. vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
sn22.79:13.3: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
sn22.79:14.1: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, bhikkhu nevācināti na apacināti, apacinitvā ṭhito. neva pajahati, na upādiyati, pajahitvā ṭhito. neva visineti na ussineti. visinetvā ṭhito neva vidhūpeti na sandhūpeti vidhūpetvā ṭhito.
sn22.79:14.2: kiñca nevācināti na apacināti apacinitvā ṭhito:
sn22.79:14.3: rūpaṃ nevācināti, na apacināti, apacinitvā ṭhito.
sn22.79:14.7: viññāṇaṃ nevācināti, na apacināti. apacinitvā ṭhito.
sn22.79:14.8: kiñca neva pajahati na upādiyati pajahitvā ṭhito:
sn22.79:14.9: rūpaṃ neva pajahati na upādiyati pajahitvā ṭhito.
sn22.79:14.10: vedanaṃ neva pajahati na upādiyati pajahitvā ṭhito.
sn22.79:14.13: viññāṇaṃ neva pajahati na upādiyati. pajahitvā ṭhito.
sn22.79:14.14: kiñca neva visineti, na ussineti, visinetvā ṭhito:
sn22.79:14.15: rūpaṃ neva visineti na ussineti visinetvā ṭhito.
sn22.79:14.16: vedanaṃ neva visineti, na ussineti, visinetvā ṭhito.
sn22.79:14.19: viññāṇaṃ neva visineti, na ussineti, visinetvā ṭhito.
sn22.79:14.20: kiñca neva vidhūpeti na sandhūpeti vidhūpetvā ṭhito:
sn22.79:14.21: rūpaṃ neva vidhūpeti na sandhūpeti vidhūpetvā ṭhito.
sn22.79:14.25: viññāṇaṃ neva vidhūpeti na sandhūpeti vidhūpetvā ṭhito.
sn22.79:14.26: evaṃ vimuttacittaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhuṃ saindā devā sabrahmakā sapajāpatikā ārakāva namassanti:
